name: cells
title: fields.cells
lead: A scattered grid, one point per `size` blocks: the distance to the nearest point, and that point's own number 0..1.
signature: fields.cells(size: number, seed: number ?) → { distance: Field, random: Field }

usedIn.quote: fields.cells(size, seed)                    -- { distance = field, random = field }: the nearest point of a scattered grid
